name: The Goat's Beard
description: This cozy, rustic Main Street mainstay turns locally sourced ingredients into elevated comfort food and shareable bar bites. Regulars come back for the cheesesteak egg rolls, Detroit-style pizza, and a friendly bar that keeps the room buzzing.

name: Lucky's Last Chance
description: A beloved Main Street burger-and-dog joint dressing up its griddled classics with toppings like mac and cheese, chili, and pulled pork. It doubles as one of the warmest bars in the neighborhood, with a deep lineup of beers and cocktails.

name: Bar Jawn
description: From the team behind the acclaimed Pizza Jawn, this spot serves gooey, saucy comfort food with an unmistakably Philly accent. Expect generous portions of chicken parm, cheesesteaks, wings, and burgers in a laid-back setting.

name: Jake's and Cooper's
description: A Main Street institution for nearly four decades, pairing an extensive wine list with polished American plates and gourmet pizzas. Longtime favorites like the crab cakes, short rib pizza, and ribeye keep the dining room busy.

name: SOMO
description: SOMO brings a speakeasy-inspired vibe to Main Street with small plates, sandwiches, and elevated entrees in an industrial-chic space. Playful signature cocktails round out a menu built for a stylish night out.

name: Taqueria Amor
description: A colorful, family-friendly taqueria dishing out approachable Mexican favorites like chicken tinga tacos, street corn, and enchiladas. A lengthy tequila and cocktail list plus daily specials make it a lively happy-hour destination.

name: Yanako
description: Manayunk's go-to for sushi, Yanako turns out fresh nigiri, sashimi, and creative rolls alongside cooked Japanese standards. The intimate Main Street dining room makes it a reliable pick for a relaxed dinner.

name: At Ramen MNYK
description: A casual, comforting ramen shop whose deeply simmered broths are the perfect fuel for climbing Manayunk's hills. The spicy katsu ramen and crispy takoyaki are among the most-ordered plates.

name: Mia Ragazza
description: A warm, contemporary Italian spot on Main Street serving handmade pastas and classic Italian mains. It rounds out the neighborhood's dining scene with a date-night-worthy atmosphere.

name: Manayunk Brewing Company
description: An iconic riverside brewpub pouring house-made craft beers alongside a crowd-pleasing American menu. The breezy deck overlooking the Schuylkill and dishes like the fish tacos make it a Manayunk staple.
